face.name: Ambush

face.flavorText: "I know some new tricks, a lot of good tricks. I will show them to you. Medivh will not mind at all if I do."

face.flavorText: “当第三张牌的光芒初现，我便会及时赶来。”

face.name: Galloping Savior
face.text: Secret: After your opponent plays three cards in a turn, summon a 3/4 Steed with Taunt.
face.flavorText: "Look to my coming on the first light of the third card."

face.name: 缠人处境
face.text: 奥秘：在你的对手施放一个法术后，召唤一只3/4并具有潜行的蜘蛛。
face.flavorText: “这就是我所说的……”“……闭嘴吧你。”

face.name: Sticky Situation
face.text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
face.flavorText: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

face.name: 铁鬃灰熊
face.text: 嘲讽
face.flavorText: “瘦死的棕熊比兽人大。”

face.name: Ironfur Grizzly
face.text: Taunt
face.flavorText: "Bear Carcass 1/10"

face.name: 帝王眼镜蛇
face.text: 剧毒
face.flavorText: 索拉查盆地栖息着很多非常恐怖的生物。如果你一定要去那里，带上杀虫剂，还要穿上板甲。

face.name: Emperor Cobra
face.text: Poisonous
face.flavorText: The Sholazar Basin is home to a lot of really horrible things. If you're going to visit, wear bug spray. And plate armor.

known_local_policies: All named summons use ordinary SummonByCard with exact actual card identities. The five new noncollectible token identities are verified by both complete primary parent childIds and full static rows. No separate token HTTP faces are claimed.

Bear Trap uses existing CS2_125 Ironfur Grizzly3/3 Taunt and Venomstrike Trap uses existing EX1_170 Emperor Cobra2/3 Poisonous. Full existing rows and two primary faces each are pinned. These two exact named mappings have no childIds in primary parents, so remain explicit local identity policies pending CN calibration rather than invented token IDs.

Snake Trap accepts three separate ordinary named-summon requests attributed to the same original secret. Ordinary quantity expansion, capacity and individual entry reactions remain shared; no alternative-candidate inventory is misused as a multi-summon list.

Pack Tactics copies the current original attacked friendly residence using shared SummonStats3/3, which clears damage. Shadow Clone reads the original actual completed attack against this hero and a still-live original minion entry, then uses current copy plus a pre-entry Stealth grant. Shadow Clone wording does not add an enemy-minion source restriction.

Original completed CAST, actual played-minion residence and physical hand-play prefix reuse existing shared queries. All ten require ordinary board space. GIL_577 retains the existing canonical Rat Trap secret key/deck identity.
Exact original reveal, source/control changes, copy material and reaction windows are local policies; no full source is cropped and the complete72 source remains closed pending remaining effects.
